description: Collect what the escrow owes this wallet — payments for delivered work, refunds from cancelled jobs — and what the board with rules owes it — refunds of withdrawn or expired jobs, leftovers from a cheaper offer — in EVERY currency, one transaction each. Both are pull payment: they credit balances and never push them, so money sits there until this is called. Call panal_wallet first to see what is waiting.
